raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

vLLM's OpenAI server accepts the session identity as an `X-Session-ID` request header, so callers and proxies can leave the JSON body untouched. `sgl-router` already routes on this same header — it is its default `--session-id-header` — but the Python server ignored it, so the backend dropped the identity the router had just routed on.

## Changes

- `apply_session_id_header()` in `entrypoints/request_headers.py` fills `session_id` from `X-Session-ID` when the body leaves it unset.
- A body `session_id` always wins; this only fills a missing value.
- The header is ignored when `session_params` is present, because the scheduler treats the two session forms as mutually exclusive.
- Applied in the route handlers for `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/invocations` and the native `/generate` (`serve_generate_request`), which previously honored only the `x-override-*` headers.

### Why the route, not the adapted request

`session_id` already exists on `ChatCompletionRequest` / `CompletionRequest` / `ResponsesRequest`, so the header is written to the request object before dispatch instead of to the `GenerateReqInput` adapted from it. Two pieces of existing logic inspect the request first and would otherwise disagree with the backend:

- `GenerateReqInput` rejects `session_id` and `session_params` together (`io_struct.py`), and the `session_params` guard here depends on seeing the body value.
- The Unlimited-OCR v2 document splitter refuses to split a request that carries a session (`models/unlimited_ocr_v2_support/chat.py`, `_is_splittable`). With the header applied after adaptation, such a request would still be split into N windows, each registering the same session id.

The adapted request copies `session_id=request.session_id` as it already did, so no serving module changes.

## Tests

Added to `test/registered/cpu/test_request_headers.py` (`stage-a-test-cpu-intel`):

- Five unit cases on the helper: header fills an unset `session_id`, the body wins, absent/empty header is ignored, `session_params` disables it.
- Three route-level cases that post through a FastAPI app to the native `/generate` route and assert the captured `GenerateReqInput` carries the id.
- Two route-level cases that post to the real `/v1/chat/completions` route and assert the header is on the request object before dispatch.

### Known limitation

The Rust frontend (`SGLANG_RUST_SERVER`) parses only the `x-override-*` / routing-key headers, so it does not yet read `X-Session-ID`. Nothing here changes that; it is a separate parity gap.

No release-notes label needed: behavior only changes for requests that explicitly send the header.

@@ -18,6 +18,33 @@
     "x-override-priority": ("priority", int),
 }
 
+# Same header the vLLM OpenAI server accepts, and the one sgl-router already
+# uses for sticky session routing.
+SESSION_ID_HEADER = "x-session-id"
+
+
+def apply_session_id_header(obj, headers) -> None:
+    """Fall back to ``X-Session-ID`` when the body carries no session identity.
+
+    The body always wins: this only fills a missing ``session_id``, so a caller
+    that sets the field explicitly is unaffected. ``session_params`` describes a
+    scheduler-managed session and is mutually exclusive with ``session_id``, so
+    the header is ignored when ``session_params`` is present.
+
+    Callers apply this to the request object before dispatch, not to the
+    ``GenerateReqInput`` built from it, so the identity is visible to anything
+    that inspects the request early: ``GenerateReqInput`` validation rejects
+    ``session_id`` together with ``session_params``, and the Unlimited-OCR v2
+    document splitter refuses to split a request that carries a session.
+    """
+    if getattr(obj, "session_id", None) is not None:
+        return
+    if getattr(obj, "session_params", None) is not None:
+        return
+    value = headers.get(SESSION_ID_HEADER)
+    if value:
+        obj.session_id = value
+
 
 def apply_header_overrides(obj, headers) -> None:
     """Override request based on header values. Fail the request when any override has issues."""

@@ -1,14 +1,19 @@
 import unittest
 from types import SimpleNamespace
 
-from fastapi import HTTPException
+from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
 from starlette.datastructures import Headers
 
-from sglang.srt.entrypoints.request_headers import apply_header_overrides
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints import http_server
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.request_headers import (
+    apply_header_overrides,
+    apply_session_id_header,
+)
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
-register_cpu_ci(est_time=4, suite="stage-a-test-cpu-intel")
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="stage-a-test-cpu-intel")
 
 
 def _obj():
@@ -106,5 +111,136 @@ def test_invalid_priority_fails_loud(self):
             apply_header_overrides(obj, Headers({"x-override-priority": "high"}))
 
 
+def _session_obj():
+    return SimpleNamespace(session_id=None, session_params=None)
+
+
+class TestApplySessionIdHeader(CustomTestCase):
+    """``X-Session-ID`` is the same header the vLLM OpenAI server accepts."""
+
+    def test_header_fills_missing_session_id(self):
+        obj = _session_obj()
+        apply_session_id_header(obj, Headers({"x-session-id": "conv-1"}))
+        self.assertEqual(obj.session_id, "conv-1")
+
+    def test_body_session_id_wins(self):
+        obj = _session_obj()
+        obj.session_id = "from-body"
+        apply_session_id_header(obj, Headers({"x-session-id": "from-header"}))
+        self.assertEqual(obj.session_id, "from-body")
+
+    def test_absent_header_leaves_session_id_none(self):
+        obj = _session_obj()
+        apply_session_id_header(obj, Headers({}))
+        self.assertIsNone(obj.session_id)
+
+    def test_empty_header_is_ignored(self):
+        obj = _session_obj()
+        apply_session_id_header(obj, Headers({"x-session-id": ""}))
+        self.assertIsNone(obj.session_id)
+
+    def test_session_params_disables_header(self):
+        # The scheduler treats session_params and session_id as mutually
+        # exclusive, so the header must not create the invalid combination.
+        obj = _session_obj()
+        obj.session_params = {"id": "managed-session"}
+        apply_session_id_header(obj, Headers({"x-session-id": "conv-1"}))
+        self.assertIsNone(obj.session_id)
+
+
+class TestGenerateRouteAppliesSessionIdHeader(CustomTestCase):
+    """The native ``/generate`` route reads ``X-Session-ID`` like the OpenAI routes."""
+
+    def _serve(self, body, headers):
+        served = []
+
+        class FakeTokenizerManager:
+            async def generate_request(self, obj, request):
+                served.append(obj)
+                yield {"text": "ok"}
+
+        app = FastAPI()
+        app.add_api_route("/generate", http_server.generate_request, methods=["POST"])
+        prior_state = http_server.get_global_state()
+        http_server.set_global_state(
+            SimpleNamespace(tokenizer_manager=FakeTokenizerManager())
+        )
+        try:
+            response = TestClient(app).post("/generate", json=body, headers=headers)
+        finally:
+            http_server.set_global_state(prior_state)
+        return response, served
+
+    def test_header_fills_missing_session_id(self):
+        response, served = self._serve({"text": "hi"}, {"X-Session-ID": "conv-1"})
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(served[0].session_id, "conv-1")
+
+    def test_body_session_id_wins(self):
+        response, served = self._serve(
+            {"text": "hi", "session_id": "from-body"}, {"X-Session-ID": "conv-1"}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(served[0].session_id, "from-body")
+
+    def test_session_params_disables_header(self):
+        response, served = self._serve(
+            {"text": "hi", "session_params": {"id": "managed"}},
+            {"X-Session-ID": "conv-1"},
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertIsNone(served[0].session_id)
+
+
+class TestChatRouteAppliesSessionIdHeader(CustomTestCase):
+    """The OpenAI routes fill ``session_id`` before the request is dispatched.
+
+    The identity is written to the request object rather than to the adapted
+    ``GenerateReqInput``, so anything that inspects the request first -- the
+    ``session_id``/``session_params`` conflict check and the Unlimited-OCR v2
+    doc splitter -- sees the same value the backend will use.
+    """
+
+    def _post(self, body, headers):
+        seen = []
+
+        class FakeChatServing:
+            async def handle_request(self, request, raw_request):
+                seen.append(request)
+                return {"ok": True}
+
+        app = FastAPI()
+        app.add_api_route(
+            "/v1/chat/completions",
+            http_server.openai_v1_chat_completions,
+            methods=["POST"],
+        )
+        app.state.openai_serving_chat = FakeChatServing()
+        response = TestClient(app).post(
+            "/v1/chat/completions", json=body, headers=headers
+        )
+        return response, seen
+
+    def test_header_fills_session_id_before_dispatch(self):
+        response, seen = self._post(
+            {"model": "m", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]},
+            {"X-Session-ID": "conv-1"},
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(seen[0].session_id, "conv-1")
+
+    def test_body_session_id_wins(self):
+        response, seen = self._post(
+            {
+                "model": "m",
+                "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
+                "session_id": "from-body",
+            },
+            {"X-Session-ID": "conv-1"},
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(seen[0].session_id, "from-body")
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
